newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp on Wednesday said that it qualified six municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively, for insurance.
--Dixion Public Financing Authority, Calif., $3.3 million Lease Revenue, direct purchase.
--Deerfield Public School District, Mich., $1.9 million General Obligations.
--Kingsport, Tenn., Tax and Revenue, $3.8 million direct purchase.
--Kingsport, Tenn., Tax and Revenue, $1.7 million direct purchase.
--Knox County, Tenn., $70 million Public Improvement GOs.
